mechanism.primary_single_causal_chain: warmup-induced exploration collapse -> blind split-gates lock-in -> impotent lambda windup. During the 300-round lambda=0 warmup, hazard cost is invisible to the gradient so sensing is PURE reward-cost (DR-D1 -0.5*sensing_cost, ~-0.025/sense with sensing_cost_value=0.05) with NO benefit channel; the reward-only objective trains sensing OUT before the constraint activates. The DR-D1 penalty is the INSTRUMENT through which warmup kills sensing (inseparable), not an independent cause. The 0.01 gated entropy 'floor' (a conditional bonus, NOT a hard clamp) is far too weak to hold it.
mechanism.compounding_M5: cost-critic layout-aliasing CONFIRMED — central_state_from_stage23 is byte-identical (torch.equal True) for the two aliased fork layouts (schema encodes hazard_cell_count, NOT location); cost EV stuck ~0.37. Even with live sensing the cost advantage cannot cleanly credit sense->safe. Compounding limiter, NOT primary (a perfect critic cannot help a policy that never senses).
mechanism.secondary_accelerant_PBRS_UNVERIFIED: task_progress_potential_weight=0.05 adds a dense goal-distance gradient that likely SPEEDS lock-in of the blind route; not primary (sensing died round ~40, well before sustained success); magnitude UNVERIFIED.
mechanism.timing_smoking_gun: sensing collapses below 0.01 at rounds 217/245/297 (all DURING the 300-round warmup); lambda first exceeds 1.0 at rounds 329/331/330 (just AFTER warmup). Sensing was dead before the constraint that would reward it turned on, and before sustained success (rounds ~136/121/174).

confounds.a_actor_reveal_actionability_RESOLVED: The actor's reveal->movement pathway is ARCHITECTURALLY INTACT and weakly active but under-trained. Forcing sensing produced real reveals; the learned actor's movement argmax NEVER flips under do(reveal:=0) (movement_flips_on_reveal=False all seeds/layouts), BUT the reveal DOES move the movement logits (max delta 0.68-0.78 s111, 0.14-0.21 s113) — the GRU passes the reveal signal, it is just too weak to override the deterministic route. This does NOT moot the route (no actor rebuild needed); it CONFIRMS L3 (reward sense->movement-change) is NECESSARY to reinforce the existing-but-weak pathway. Contrast M-5, which IS a genuine architecture gap on the CRITIC side.
